subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google presents Vertex AI as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: Source inspection confirms stale visible copy, but the issue’s proposed wording differs from current Google docs and the provider id is compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use bridged Google docs wording
options.body: Update visible labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or equivalent bridged wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable id.

options.title: Keep current label for now
options.body: Leave `Google Vertex AI` until Google’s API/docs and OpenClaw’s provider docs intentionally converge on a new shorter label.

options.title: Use shorter Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a shorter `Gemini Enterprise` label, but document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex API/ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use bridged Google docs wording
recommendation.body: Update visible labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or equivalent bridged wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable id.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is mostly UI/docs/provider-label copy, and this login introduced the current provider-contract label in merged history.
